description: Use this when the user asks about AAVE governance — 'Show me recent AAVE governance proposals', 'What proposals are currently active?', 'What is the status of AAVE proposal #X?', 'Show me governance voting activity'. Queries the AAVE Governance V3 subgraph on Ethereum. Returns: proposal ID, creator, access level (1=short executor/2=long executor), current state, voting duration (seconds), for/against votes, title, and payload info. Proposal states: Created=0, Active=1, Queued=2, Executed=3, Failed=4, Cancelled=5, Expired=6.

first.description: Number of proposals to return (1–50, default 10)

name: get_governance_proposals
